takes.sourceDescription: B sits; A pulls up B (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Pull seated partner up, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A walks forward, bends and extends a hand downward, pulls while stepping and turning, then releases and stands.

takes.sourceDescription: A sits; B pulls up A (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Rise with partner's help, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A starts seated, raises a hand, leans forward and stands, then takes steps away.

takes.sourceDescription: A sits, holds face in hands; B kneels, comforts A (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Seated and comforted, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A remains seated with head bowed and hands near the face, then raises the head and one arm near the end.

takes.sourceDescription: B comforts A, puts one hand on A's shoulder (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Receive shoulder comfort, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A takes a few steps and stands with head and shoulders bowed, then lifts slightly near the end.

takes.sourceDescription: A comforts B, puts both hands on B's shoulders (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Comfort partner at shoulders, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A raises both hands, leans forward and reaches out at shoulder height, then straightens and lowers the arms.

takes.sourceDescription: B comforts A, puts both hands on A's shoulders (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Receive two-handed comfort, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps into standing, leans slightly and remains upright with arms low.

takes.sourceDescription: A comforts B, puts one hand on B's shoulder (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Comfort partner at shoulder, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A holds one hand raised and extended while standing and making small weight shifts.

takes.sourceDescription: hold hands, swing arms, walk (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Hold hands and walk, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A walks with an arm extended, swings it forward and back, and continues stepping through the end.

takes.sourceDescription: A gives B a shoulder rub; B sits, A stands (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Give shoulder rub, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A stands leaning forward with both hands extended downward, making repeated small hand and arm movements.

takes.sourceDescription: A shelters B, a younger child, from harm (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Shelter a child, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps into a wide stance, spreads the arms and turns with bent knees, then draws the arms down and returns upright.

takes.sourceDescription: B shelters A, a younger child, from harm (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Sheltered child, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A starts standing and shifts into a wide bent-knee stance, looking upward and lowering the body through the end.

takes.sourceDescription: A stumbles into B (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Stumble into partner, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A starts in a quick leaning step with hands raised, recovers balance and settles upright.

takes.sourceDescription: A passes soda to B; both drink (2 subjects - subject A)
takes.title: Pass soda and drink, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A raises a hand to the mouth, moves an arm outward, then lowers the arms and stands.
